other_conditions: Applicant must be a startup certified by the Startup Promotion Cell (SPC) and possess a valid startup certificate number.
The startup must have successfully registered its trademark.
Expenditures must be incurred after the notification of Goa Startup Policy 2017, be within the validity of the policy, and be paid digitally; otherwise, approval is at the discretion of the SPC.
Application must be submitted within 6 months of incurring the relevant expenditure.
benefits_summary: 50% reimbursement of trademark registration cost up to ₹25,000 for eligible startups.
